Three core lessons at the heart of it

In weeks 2, 4, and 6, students go deep on the skills that change a classroom's culture. Every core lesson runs 25–30 minutes and comes with a teacher guide, a printable worksheet, and a self-grading quiz — score 80% or higher to pass and unlock what comes next.

Week 2 · Core lesson

Spotting the Signs

Students learn to notice when a classmate is struggling, left out, or being targeted — the quiet signals that are easy to miss — and what a caring first response looks like.

  • Teacher guide
  • Printable worksheet
  • Self-grading quiz · 80% to pass
Week 4 · Core lesson

The Power of Empathy

Students practice stepping into someone else's shoes: listening to understand, naming feelings accurately, and responding in ways that actually help.

  • Teacher guide
  • Printable worksheet
  • Self-grading quiz · 80% to pass
Week 6 · Core lesson

From Bystander to Upstander

Students learn safe, realistic ways to step in, speak up, or get help when they witness unkindness — and rehearse the words before they ever need them.

  • Teacher guide
  • Printable worksheet
  • Self-grading quiz · 80% to pass

Everything a teacher needs, in the box

No scrambling for materials the night before. Each core lesson is a complete, ready-to-teach package.

● Teacher guides

Step-by-step guides for every core lesson — timing, discussion prompts, and answers — so any teacher or substitute can pick it up and teach.

● Printable worksheets

A worksheet for every core lesson that students complete during class, designed to print cleanly on standard school printers.

● Self-grading quizzes

Quizzes grade themselves. Students need 80% or higher to pass, and passing unlocks the next stage of the curriculum.
